actual_scope: Independently audit the field sensitivity of PR1417 Certificate A by rebuilding all 5,824 P112 edge tensors from the selected source archive, computing their ranks over F2 and F1009, and checking the theorem proof’s explicit field contract.
scope_change_reason: The user-assigned structural track has no dedicated catalogue card; this exact finite structural premise is an adjacent scoped audit. An initial characteristic-zero reading was rejected after the pinned proof explicitly stated F2 and characteristic two. The contribution therefore reports field sensitivity, not a theorem counterexample.
bottleneck_link: A graph-rank premise used to constrain endpoint-plane structure must be applied over the same field as its subspace and lift maps. The result prevents an invalid cross-characteristic inference; it changes no supplier price or kappa.
stop_rule: Recompute the complete ordered edge-tensor rank from the pinned selected port set over F2 and one certified odd prime; produce an 81x81 nonzero minor if the odd-characteristic rank is full; read and pin the target proof’s field assumptions. Stop at this finite field-contract audit; do not infer or audit the full endpoint/cost theorem.
evidence: The 5,824 edge tensors have rank 80 over F2 and 81 over F1009. An explicit 81x81 pivot minor has nonzero determinant modulo prime 1009, proving characteristic-zero rank 81. Exact witnesses show port 0 has integer self-dot 3 and edge (0,1) has integer dot 2; both identities reduce to the intended F2 values 1 and 0. PR1417 PROOF.md explicitly states F2^9 and characteristic two, so this does not refute its stated theorem.
